stage0040_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Where are you hiding, damn woman!
　Get out here already!」

stage0040_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Altair Soldier
「Lord $$カグラ$$...!
　Isn't Lord $$ジン$$ also in this town...!」

stage0040_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like I care!
　If $$ジン$$ took a stray shot,
　that's just how it is!」

stage0040_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Abductors!
　Deploying across $$アクエリア市$$!」

stage0040_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$クレア$$
「No need to worry.
　They have arrived」

stage0040_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Let's do our best, $$ミコノ$$...!
　To protect $$アクエリア市$$ too!」

stage0040_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's right!
　We can't lose the fight in our hearts first!」

stage0040_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Listen to them talk now, those two」

stage0040_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アルト$$
「We can't afford to lose either!」

stage0040_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　The enemy's core is that beast bastard!」

stage0040_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$葵$$
（That name... it gives me mixed feelings...）

stage0040_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「To keep the damage to the city from spreading,
　let's take him down quickly」

stage0040_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it!
　Why can't we beat them!」

stage0040_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Looks like you're struggling, $$カグラ$$」

stage0040_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up and watch, $$ミカゲ$$!
　I'm not beaten yet!」

stage0040_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How cute, that bravado of yours.
　Well then, allow me to help you」

stage0040_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$キャシー$$
「It's not a dimensional gate appearing...!
　This is a defold reaction!」

stage0040_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you thinking, $$ミカゲ$$!
　What is that bug!?」

stage0040_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is the trans-dimensional life form...
　It exists since the universe's birth, to witness its end」

stage0040_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シモン$$
「What's going on, $$アルト$$!?
　Didn't the Vajra come to understand humans
　through $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$'s song!?」

stage0040_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even we don't really understand it!
　Even $$ランカ$$'s song isn't getting through to them!」

stage0040_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ダリー$$
「But, if this keeps up, the city...!」

stage0040_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Guess that means we gotta fight!」

stage0040_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hahahahaha, what lovely chaos.
　This will be a sight to see」

stage0040_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$...
　why do you look so sad...）

stage0040_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What happened between you and him...?）

stage0040_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$赤木$$
「This isn't the time to chase him!
　First, we protect the city!」

stage0040_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「Vajra...!
　Is there nothing we can do!?」

stage0040_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Looks like you're struggling, $$カグラ$$」

stage0040_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up and watch, $$ミカゲ$$!
　I'm not beaten yet!」

stage0040_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:

「How cute, that bravado of yours.
　Well then, allow me to help you」

stage0040_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:

stage0040_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:

stage0040_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:

stage0040_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:

stage0040_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:

stage0040_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:

「Guess that means we gotta fight!」

stage0040_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hahahahaha, what lovely chaos.
　This will be a sight to see」

stage0040_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now then, $$カグラ$$... fight to your heart's content」

stage0040_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it all!
　Fine, then! Both them and the bugs,
　I'll smash 'em all at once!」

stage0040_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$赤木$$
「This isn't the time to focus only on him!
　First, we protect the city!」

stage0040_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アルト$$
「Vajra...!
　Is there nothing we can do!?」

stage0040_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$田中司令$$
「A battle royale between Abductors and Vajra...
　That was quite the tough one」

stage0040_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ＷＩＬＬ$$...
　What was the situation when the Vajra appeared?」

stage0040_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「An unnatural boundary distortion was confirmed
　right before, and the Vajra folded in on it」

stage0040_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...Is there a chance the Vajra itself
　was folded in by someone's hand...?」

stage0040_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Distorting a boundary this stable, let alone
　summoning Vajra that would be in a parallel
　world, is inconceivable」

stage0040_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We must also account for the possibility
　that such an inconceivable enemy exists...」

stage0040_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Good work out there, everyone.
　Return to base at once」

stage0040_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it!
　Why can't we beat them!」

stage0040_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's simple, $$カグラ$$...
　it's because you're weak」

stage0040_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$...
　why do you look so sad...）

stage0040_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What happened between you and him...?）

stage0040_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Move it, scentless man!
　I don't have time for you!」

stage0040_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Of course!
　That damn woman is mine!」

stage0040_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't decide that on your own!
　$$ミコノ$$ is... $$ミコノ$$ is...!」

stage0040_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Interesting!
　So you're fired up now!」

stage0040_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Then I'll teach you!
　Just how powerless and useless you really are!」

stage0040_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Found you, damn woman!
　I came here to kill you
　with my own hands!」

stage0040_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Fine, damn woman!
　I'll hear you out plenty later!」

stage0040_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You're a member of Element!
　And he's our enemy!」

stage0040_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Gonna resist, damn woman!?
　But it's pointless, and I'll show you why!」

stage0040_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... I'll fight too...!
　Together with $$アマタ$$ and the others...!」

stage0040_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アルト$$
（I believe we'll understand each other someday...!
　But for now...!）

stage0040_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Right now, my job is protecting people!
　So I'll fight!!」

stage0040_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シンジ$$
（The people who live in this city...
　$$聖天使学園$$ is waiting for our help...）

stage0040_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Just wait, $$ジン$$...!
　We'll definitely protect everyone...）
